projects.title: Dealer Review
projects.description: An invitation-only vehicle assessment platform for car dealerships. Dealers submit vehicle details, photos and a condition rating through a private portal, and the review team returns a recommended listing price with a branded report. Includes a dealership workspace that tracks every submission, plus membership and billing.
